name: 并发安全与热路径性能

question.instructions: Evaluate Concurrency and Performance: no coarse-grained method-level synchronized locks on hot read paths, zero phantom polling.

criteria.passed: No coarse-grained method-level synchronized locks on hot read paths; uses fine-grained or lock-free mechanisms; zero phantom polling/probing.
criteria.violated: Method-level synchronized lock used on hot data read path, or phantom polling/probing introduced.

why: 核心正交架构红线：高并发读取热路径禁止方法级大粒度排他锁，禁止跨线程/跨数据源的幽灵轮询与反查探测。
